items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: when I was over there later on with Rap Harrison

ctx.x: in Harlem where you could drop in and hear Duke or whatever, you know?

Well, when we got back to Harlem, I didn't want to leave it. No, I missed it very much and even when I was over there later on with Rap Harrison, I used to say to him, "I certainly would like to get back in Harlem and go to a breakfast dance, or something." I didn't realize that they had stopped having breakfast dances -- but that's what, oh, you missed that. And you missed a place called an after hours club, you know?
